text.lead: The Intended is a 2002 English-language period drama film directed by Kristian Levring and starring Janet McTeer (who also co-wrote the screenplay), JJ Feild, Olympia Dukakis, Tony Maudsley and Brenda Fricker. It centres on a surveyor and his fiancée who arrive in a remote Malaysian trading post and encounter a close-fisted ivory trader and her ill-meaning family.
text.cast:
- Janet McTeer as Sarah Morris
- JJ Feild as Hamish Winslow
- Olympia Dukakis as Erina
- Brenda Fricker as Mrs. Jones
- Tony Maudsley as William Jones
- David Bradley as The Priest
- Philip Jackson as Norton
- John Matthew Lau as Judas
- Robert Pugh as Le Blanc
text.reception: The Intended currently holds a 33% rating on the Rotten Tomatoes website.
